# graph

TypeScript-first in-memory property graph database with Cypher-compatible queries and type-safe TinkerPop/Gremlin traversal API. Compiles textual queries via Peggy-generated parser into executable step pipelines with compile-time path type tracking. Part of codemix product intelligence platform.

## Stack

- **Module**: ESM-only, exports `./dist/index.js` with types at `./dist/index.d.ts`
- **Parser**: Peggy 5.1.0 for Cypher-like grammar compilation
- **Schema Validation**: Standard Schema v1 via `@standard-schema/spec`
- **Text Search**: BM25 via `@codemix/text-search` workspace dependency
- **Testing**: Vitest with 20s timeout, Istanbul coverage (excludes `src/grammar.js`)
- **Build**: `build:grammar` script compiles `grammar.peggy` to `grammar.js`, then TypeScript compilation to `dist/`

## Contents

- [package.json](./package.json) — ESM manifest with `build`, `build:grammar`, `test` scripts. Deps: `@codemix/text-search`, `@standard-schema/spec`, `peggy`, `vitest`, `typescript`.
- [tsconfig.json](./tsconfig.json) — Extends `../tsconfig-common.json`, `outDir: "./dist"`, `rootDir: "src"`, `composite: true`, references `../text-search`.

## Configuration

**Grammar Compilation**: `scripts.build:grammar` in [package.annex.sum](./package.annex.sum) runs peggy with return-types plugin to generate `src/grammar.js` from `src/grammar.peggy`.

**Project References**: [tsconfig.json](./tsconfig.json) references `../text-search` for workspace dependency resolution.

## Behavioral Contracts

**Element Identifier Format**: `ElementId<TLabel>` template literal `` `${TLabel}:${string}` ``. Example: `Person:12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc`. Parsing via `parseElementId(id)` splits on first colon, throws `` `Invalid element id: ${id}` `` if malformed. Full specification: [src/AGENTS.md](./src/AGENTS.md) Behavioral Contracts section.

**Default Resource Limits**: `maxIterations: 1000`, `maxCollectionSize: 100000` defined in [src/QueryContext.ts](./src/QueryContext.ts) via `DEFAULT_QUERY_CONTEXT_OPTIONS`.

**Grammar Compilation Output**: `grammar.js` generated from `grammar.peggy` with `StartRules: ["MultiStatement"]`, exporting `parse(input, options)` and `SyntaxError` class with `expected`/`found`/`location` fields. Full temporal format regex patterns and error message templates documented in [src/AGENTS.md](./src/AGENTS.md).
